name: FORGE
features: Kickoff of the public 50-step roadmap (steps 01–10 implemented; remaining items tracked)
Keyboard skip link, focusable named main landmark and accessible navigation labels
Automatic active-tab aria-current, aria-pressed and polite route announcements
Alt+1–5 shortcuts for five main sections and published shortcut hints
Built-in keyboard help dialog with Escape, focus trap and Settings entry
Improved visible focus, accessible touch sizing and reduced-motion handling
Workouts, foods, watch imports, account data and progress records preserved
